messages:
Ivy: dropped a fresh mock for the Usage & Billing page (compact-first). Key change: invoice row collapsed with a small chevron to expand history. PTAL :eyes:
Sam: looks good. Q: when collapsed, where does Download live? single primary button or menu?
Ivy: single primary Download on the row, chevron opens history with per-invoice actions. keeps 1-click for common case.
Ravi: accessibility thought: collapsed invoice pill needs an accessible name and expose formats (PDF/CSV) via menu. Also color alone shouldn't indicate overdue.
Jo: agree. propose: pill shows icon + amount, visually display "Overdue" label for small screens as hidden SR text, and a chevron menu for format choices.
design-bot: a11y check: legend contrast fails at 360px, scope toggle missing aria-pressed, invoice chevron not keyboard-focusable.
Ivy: noted. I'll bump contrast, add aria-pressed to scope toggle, and ensure chevron is in tab order and has aria-haspopup="menu".
Sam: copy tweak: instead of long button labels, show primary "Download" and menu items "PDF" / "CSV". keeps translations short.
Ravi: UX question: when you switch scope to Project, should left chart update to project-only or keep org mini? I vote project-only to reduce clutter, but keep a small link to return to Org.
Jo: project-only + breadcrumb link back sounds good. Also legend overflow: show up to 3 swatches then a "+n" chip opening a focusable popover.
Ivy: telemetry request: add flag `billing.ui_compact` and events `billing.invoice_click`, `billing.format_selected`, `billing.scope_change`, `billing.history_expanded`. run 7-day 2% experiment.
design-bot: keyboard flow suggestion: DOM order should be invoice row -> download button -> scope toggle -> charts. popover must trap focus and close on Esc.
Sam: microcopy under spend chart: "Estimated monthly spend; actual invoice may vary." short, clear.
Ravi: localization note: make sure menu labels are single-word where possible for some RTL languages.
Ivy: will update Figma: increase contrast, add ARIA attrs, make chevron keyboardable, change button/menu copy, add breadcrumb for org, and attach a short QA checklist for a11y and localization. posting updated frames shortly :raised_hands:
